FULL TEXT:
No. UIPS/24/1234 Dated 11.03.2024
ADVERTISEMENT
Applications are invited for the appointment of Guest Faculty in the following subjects for the even
semester of B.Pharm. and M.Pharm. for the academic session 2023-24 in University Institute of
Pharmaceutical Sciences, Panjab University, Chandigarh:-
Subject No. of Vacancies
Pharmaceutical Chemistry 01
Pharmacology 01
Pharmacognosy 01
Essential Qualifications:-
Good academic record as defined by the concerned University with at least 60% marks (55% for
SC/ST/Physically & Visually Handicapped) or an equivalent grade in a point scale wherever grading
system is followed at the B. Pharm. and M. Pharm. level from an Indian University or an equivalent
degree from an accredited foreign University.
Desirable:
Ph.D.
First preference will be given to Ph.D/GPAT qualified candidates
The applicants are required to fill the application form raised as per the modification of 4th
amendment available on Panjab University Website https://forms.puchd.ac.in/forms/20200122155429-
irectrecruitmentassistantprofessorapplicationformasperugcregulation2018.pdf for Assistant Professors (Page
1 to 9) and submit the application form duly filled along with the attested copies of the academic
testimonials/certificates to the Chairperson, UIPS at its email id chairperson.uips@pu.ac.in.
The candidates are also required to submit the hard copy (one copy only) to the office of the
Chairperson, University Institute of Pharmaceutical Sciences, Panjab University Chandigarh-160 014
latest by 19.03.2024.
Interview Schedule:
Subjects Pharmaceutical Chemistry/ Pharmacology/ Pharmacognosy
Date 22.03.2024
Reporting Time 2:30 p.m.
Note: No TA/DA will be paid for the interview.
Sd/-
Anil Kumar
Professor & Chairperson
UNIVERSITY INSTITUTE OF PHARMACEUTICAL SCIENCES
Panjab University, Chandigarh
